rules: No universal threshold based only on nominal aspect ratio.
Jacobian, mesh quality/distortion and measured diagnostics are mandatory checks.
Observed zones are limited to the tested domain.
Tangent conditioning remains a mandatory diagnostic.
No universal numeric cutoff is approved.
Severe conditioning with Newton failure remains explicit and fail-closed.
Opt-in cutback is allowed as a robustness mechanism.
Minimum-increment exhaustion is an explicit failure.
Adaptive recovery does not erase fixed-step history.

technical_decision.next_action: Prepare a separate TL robustness R&D plan; do not implement it here.
